Here’s a solid LinkedIn post you can use. It’s confident, forward-looking, and reflects your effort while staying professional. You can tweak the tone or length depending on your audience, but this version is ready for posting alongside your certificate:

---

🚀 **Just Completed The Web Developer Bootcamp 2.0!** 🧠💻

After weeks of intense hands-on learning, I’ve officially completed **The Web Developer Bootcamp 2.0** — a comprehensive full-stack web development course that pushed me to build real-world applications and understand the full flow of web development, from browser to backend.

🔧 **What I learned and built with:**
- HTML5, Semantic HTML, Accessibility
- CSS3, Flexbox, Animations, Responsive Design
- Bootstrap 4 & 5, CSS Frameworks
- JavaScript (modern ES6+), DOM, Async JS, APIs
- AJAX, JSON, Terminal & Unix Commands
- Node.js, NPM, Express, RESTful APIs
- MongoDB, Mongoose, Schema Design
- Authentication, Authorization, Cookies & Sessions
- Image Uploads, Geocoding, Map Integration
- Best practices in Security & Deployment

I now have a much deeper understanding of how the web works — from frontend to backend — and I’m excited to apply this knowledge to build better, scalable, and more accessible applications.

🌍 Looking forward to contributing more to the dev community and taking on real-world projects!

📄 [Certificate attached]
